description: In the OpenCAD system (http://localhost), log in as admin (admin@opencad.local / Admin123!). After logging in you will see the main dashboard with department buttons. Click the DISPATCH button to access the CAD Console. Scroll down to the Active BOLOs section and click the 'New Vehicle BOLO' button. In the BOLO form, select 'Declasse' from the Vehicle Make dropdown and 'Vigero' from the Vehicle Model dropdown (both are searchable dropdowns). Enter plate number 'XKCD420', primary color 'Black', and set the reason to: 'Vehicle used in armed robbery at Fleeca Bank on Hawick Avenue. Suspect fled southbound on Vinewood Boulevard. Consider armed and dangerous.' Set last seen location to 'Vinewood Boulevard near Eclipse Boulevard'. Click Send to create the BOLO.
